description: Which gitignore, CODEOWNERS or glob rule matches a path — Evaluates up to 25 file paths against the text of a .gitignore, a CODEOWNERS file or a list of glob patterns and reports, per path, whether it matched, the winning rule's line and pattern, and why (last match wins, directory-only rules, negation, a re-include blocked by an excluded parent directory, CODEOWNERS owner lists). Optional per-path expectations turn it into a pass/fail check, and CODEOWN

isDir.description: gitignore/glob: the path is a directory (a trailing / also says so).

path.description: Repository-relative path with / separators, at most 12 segments.

rules.description: File text, at most 300 pattern lines.

name: path-rules
